changed-responsibilities.text: The runner executes register-active-key, the receipt library validates it, the workflow asserts it and the consumer page describes what ran.

dependency-direction.text: Lean governs the runner; chain observations feed the receipt; the workflow consumes the receipt; documentation describes the workflow result.

promotion.text: Execution remains in the existing runner and shared evidence remains in the receipt library. No new cross-edge framework is introduced.

outside-this-ticket.text: Lean, validators, the request encoding, the simulator and other edges retain their existing owners.
